title: Ballet / Bobby Lee: Take Bobby's Bitcoin

prize.note: two independent cards, 1.00003481 BTC (AA009926) and 1.00003877 BTC (AA012381); a third card, AA007448, was solved and swept by a third party in 2020 and is not part of the live prize

addresses.label: AA007448 (oracle, solved by a third party in 2020, not part of the live prize)

target_format: BIP38 encrypted WIF (EC-multiply, blob prefix 0x0143) plus a passphrase (5 groups of 4 characters, about 32-symbol alphabet), decrypted to a compressed private key, derived to a P2PKH address

derivation.summary: decrypt the card's BIP38 EC-multiply encrypted WIF with its own passphrase to get a private key, derive the compressed P2PKH address, and compare it to the card's escrow address
derivation.certified_against: the solved sibling card AA007448 (encrypted WIF 6PnWfKaB...J4cH, passphrase 335Y-K745-C8WT-4D2W-80WP), reproduced byte for byte: address, WIF, and private key hex

difficulty_note: the BIP38 EC-multiply pipeline is fully confirmed against the solved sibling card; each open card publishes only one half of its BIP38 pair (encrypted WIF on the back face, passphrase on the front face under a scratch-off), and the missing half was never photographed; image forensics on all 4 published photographs recover 0 characters of either missing half; brute force of either missing half is not feasible (about 100 bits for a passphrase, one full scrypt computation per guess)

leads.title: a photograph of AA012381's back face (the missing encrypted WIF)
a photograph of AA009926's passphrase scratch-off face
a credible disclosure of a Ballet 2020 entropy weakness

sources.title: oritwoen/boha, community data mirror (addresses, encrypted WIFs, passphrases, card photographs)

third_party_material: the 4 card photographs in clues/ are the author-published puzzle itself (mirrored from Bobby Lee's own posted images via github.com/oritwoen/boha); no book, article, or other third-party copyrighted material is included
